title: Chapter 6: The First Mako Shark Attack
chineseTitle: 第 6 章：血腥引诱与首条灰真鲨攻击

paragraphs.en: The old man lashed the giant marlin alongside the skiff, raised his small sail, and turned the boat toward home. But the blood trailing from the fatal wound sank deep into the ocean waters.
paragraphs.zh: 老老人把巨型马林鱼绑在小船边，升起了他的小帆，调转船头回家。但从致命伤口拖出的血痕沉入了大洋水深深处。

paragraphs.en: One hour later, the first Mako shark arrived. It came up fast from the deep water, jaws lined with razor teeth. Santiago waited until the shark closed in, then drove his harpoon deep into its brain! The Mako sank into the abyss, but it took forty pounds of prime meat from the marlin.
paragraphs.zh: 一个小时后，第一条灰真鲨到达了。它从深水区飞快地上升，双颚排列着剃刀牙齿。圣地亚哥等待着直到鲨鱼靠近，然后将他的飞镖深深刺入了它的大脑！灰真鲨沉入了深渊，但它从马林鱼身上带走了四十磅优质的肉。
